podcast.title: Founding and Early Focus (1989)
podcast.body: The label was founded in 1989 with an initial focus on releasing music from artists aligned with the Detroit techno sound. "El Sello empezó en 1989, editando música de artistas a fines a ese tecno."

srcs.episode: Qué fue el IDM y por qué cambió la música electrónica

podcast.title: New Beginning with "Artificial Intelligence" (1992)
podcast.body: The release of the "Artificial Intelligence" compilation in 1992 marked a significant new beginning for Warp Records and for post-rave electronic music as a whole, pivoting towards a more contemplative and intellectual listening experience. "Pero no sería hasta el recoplatorio artificial Intelligence, donde marcaría a un nuevo comienzo para ellos, y para la música electrónica post-Reif."

srcs.episode: Qué fue el IDM y por qué cambió la música electrónica

podcast.title: Associated with Advanced Technology in IDM
podcast.body: IDM artists on Warp were often noted for using advanced technologies and computers in their electronic music production, setting a standard that Boards of Canada diverged from with their vintage gear. "la gente de war que hacia el idm es más duro utilizaba casi las últimas tecnologías, usaba material muy antiguo pero por ejemplo usaba los ordenadores para hacer el electrónica."

srcs.episode: BOARDS OF CANADA. La visión romántica del IDM

podcast.title: Association with Borsov-Canada
podcast.body: The Scottish band Borsov-Canada is closely associated with the electronic music current centered around the Warp label. The label is mentioned in connection with the band's musical style and influences. "Vanda que se puede escribir a la corriente EDM, focalizada en torno al sello Warp."

srcs.episode: Descifrando el disco más misterioso de la electrónica. Geogaddi

podcast.title: Association with Iconic Graphic Design
podcast.body: Warp Records is recognized for its iconic album artwork, much of which was created by Designes Republic. This design studio also provided the graphic design for the game Wipeout, a title instrumental in linking high-quality electronic music with video game aesthetics. "responsables de muchas de las portadas masíconicas del señor War Records."

srcs.episode: Por qué los videjuegos de los 2000 sonaban así? Jungle⧸Drum and Bass

podcast.title: Benchmark for Electronic Sound
podcast.body: Warp Records is referenced as a benchmark for classic British electronic music, particularly in the IDM genre. John Frusciante's 2013 electronic album, "Outsides," was described as sounding almost like a Warp release, aligning him with the label's aesthetic and influential artists such as Autechre, Aphex Twin, and Clark. "es casi un disco de warp, es casi un disco de idemen, el que padece a tecero, a pex-twing o clarco."

srcs.episode: La historia de John Frusciante: Talento, creatividad y guitarras.

podcast.title: Central to IDM Development
podcast.body: Warp Records was the central label in the development of the EDM (IDM) genre. It continued to expand the "Artificial Intelligence" series by releasing new compilations and albums by key artists like Black Dog Productions, Aotecre, and Affextwing (under his Polygon Window alias), among others. "Warp fue el Sello Central del EDM, pero se lló como Ryes y formó un clave también para dar formar género."

srcs.episode: Qué fue el IDM y por qué cambió la música electrónica

podcast.title: Commissioning Chris Cunningham
podcast.body: Warp, an electronic music label, was instrumental in Chris Cunningham's entry into directing videoclips for musical artists when they contacted him to create the video for Aphex Twin's "Tecres." "Cuando el sello de música electrónica Warp le llamó para realizar el videoclips de Tecres, se convat B.V.L."

srcs.episode: La Magia Perdida de los Videoclips de los 90s

podcast.title: Home of IDM Artists
podcast.body: Warp Records was a prominent label for intellectual electronic music, releasing works by artists like Autechre (Textuín) and Boards of Canada (The Tumbles) who were part of the IDM movement. "te cogías a textuín o te cogías a tosca o te cogías a los tublos en su ormen o a todos estos grupos de warp."

podcast.title: Hub of 90s IDM
podcast.body: Warp Records was a central label for the "hard core" of the IDM movement in the 1990s, featuring prominent artists like Autechre, Aphex Twin, and The Future Sound of London, as well as Boards of Canada. "forman parte de warp, forman parte del núcleo duro del idm que era a escorrafía guard."

srcs.episode: BOARDS OF CANADA. La visión romántica del IDM

podcast.title: Pioneering Deep Listening
podcast.body: Warp Records played a pivotal role in elevating electronic music, which originated in the rave scenes, into more experimental and profound listening territories. It transformed the perception of this music beyond its purely functional role for dancing. "La Fue Warp que enllevó esa música electrónica, nacieron en las escenas Rape, zonas más experimentales y escucha profunda."

srcs.episode: Qué fue el IDM y por qué cambió la música electrónica
